properties.name: Haulistic
properties.description:
Haulistic’s mission is to be the number one preferred third-party logistics (3PL) company for transporting commercial freight anywhere in the world. We value strong customer relationships built on trust and reliability, taking ownership of our work, and delivering results that exceed expectations.

By anticipating challenges, communicating openly with our customers, and utilizing our TMS, SilverExpress, we can make your shipping destinations feel closer than ever before.

Haulistic has unmatched experience moving large quantities of time-sensitive freight and is a subsidiary of Mullen Group, one of Canada’s largest Logistics providers. Our competitive advantage is our proprietary technology which allows us to seamlessly move Truckload, LTL, Expedite, and International shipments. By leveraging our combined freight spend, we offer customers significant cost savings and provide access to our long list of partner carriers through our free TMS, SilverExpress.

Haulistic provides customers with a dedicated operations team that manages the movement of our customer’s freight from origin to destination on time, and within budget. We have a large domestic and international shipment volume that is a distinct advantage in negotiating carrier rates and brokering freight. Our brokerage department services clients with integrity and treats their shipments with as much respect as we do our own. Our customers appreciate our ability to quickly find capacity, provide visibility, and effectively communicate every shipment from quote to final delivery.
